description: `rlsbl rewrite project-name` no longer marks its rename commit as autogenerated, so changelog coverage asks for the breaking entry the closing message prints (its runnable `rlsbl changelog add` line names that commit); the transition-record commit stays autogenerated.

`rlsbl monorepo rename-releasable` no longer marks its rename commit as autogenerated, and its closing message now prints a runnable `(cd <member> && rlsbl changelog add ... --type breaking)` line naming that commit, which clears the changelog coverage it asks for.
